verdict.scope: KyNotes web UI, branch ui/notes-eight on base 34849c4, after bundle servedIndexSha256 bb1a3b7d159d...
verdict.summary: Real typography and shell gains on desktop and phone editor; phone 'Pages in' disclosure opens onto chrome with zero visible pages, plus same-id reselect clears dirty state and named-theme danger contrast is unproven/likely failing.

inventory.inventory_correction: inventory.json records no duplicates inside the after set; workspace/editor pairs are near-duplicates under the rubric (<0.1% px, delta<=8) and are scored once on the editor file (first by name).

observations.hierarchy: Page title 'Launch checklist' 28px/600 clearly leads notebook title 24px; but two save controls compete (header outline 'Save' and footer filled 'Saved').
observations.typography: Space Grotesk throughout; editor body 15px ink-strong and H2 ~19.5px/600 are restrained; sidebar '+ New notebook' renders smaller than 'Rename notebook'/'Export notebook'.
observations.density_layout: Footer actions spread unevenly (Indent 708px, Outdent 875px, Delete 1055px, Saved 1159px) and sit on the fold with the next section's border cut at y~897; page rows carry a ~40px empty left gutter; empty 'Team notebooks' leaves a ~50px hole.
observations.color: cream panels, charcoal ink, orange only on selections and the filled footer button; recovery callout uses a brown-orange rail.
observations.visible_affordances: Selected notebook, page, section tab and Type tool are unambiguous; Outdent reads disabled; footer 'Saved' is a filled primary that looks actionable while clean.
observations.coherence: Three selection treatments (left rail on rows, underline on tab with grey top border, underline on tool) plus text glyph icons (check, diamond, pencil, arrow) and a bordered callout card inside the list column.

observations.palette_tokens: Surfaces and ink read as ky-ui cream/charcoal tokens; success green only on save status.
observations.type_geometry: 40px toolbar and footer controls, 13px meta, 8px rhythm mostly; page rows use 6px radius and page title is 28px rather than the 24px title step.
observations.shell: 240px sidebar, wordmark+stamp, account pinned bottom; account region has no sign-out (Lock lives in header) and avatar initials render as '4m'.
observations.accent_discipline: Orange on four simultaneous selection markers plus a filled 'Saved' that is not an action in this state.
observations.suite_cohesion: N/A - only KyNotes captures inspected this round

files.caveat: Fixture paragraph spacing (typed blank line) and trailing empty bullet inflate the H2 gap; cannot show hover, focus or scroll behaviour.

files.observed_surface: open page, phone, page list collapsed

observations.hierarchy: Content-first: page title 28px is the dominant element directly under two collapsed disclosure bars.
observations.typography: Body 15px Space wraps cleanly at 390px; the two disclosure labels differ (bold 16px vs regular muted 14px with a smaller '+').
observations.density_layout: Editor starts at y~180; 24px canvas inset aligns; footer select and 'Indent page' sit unbalanced at the fold.
observations.color: Only the Type tool carries accent; save status green; otherwise neutral cream/white.
observations.visible_affordances: 'Pages in Project Atlas' is muted grey with a tiny '+', reading more like a caption than a control next to the bold notebook toggle.
observations.coherence: Two stacked disclosures in different styles; native unstyled 'Quick Notes' select beside a text button.

observations.type_geometry: Controls ~40px, 8px rhythm; disclosure bars 48px vs ~40px and differing type sizes.
observations.shell: Header wordmark+Save/Settings/Lock fits; navigation split across two dissimilar disclosure bars.
observations.suite_cohesion: N/A - only KyNotes captures inspected this round

files.caveat: Near-duplicate of after-workspace-mobile (0.0036-0.0046% px, max delta 4); cannot show focus return or scrolling.

observations.hierarchy: After choosing 'Pages in Project Atlas' no page row is visible: the revealed region shows section tab, notebook heading and recovery callout, then the editor resumes at y~490.
observations.typography: Notebook heading 24px and callout 13px are legible and consistent with desktop.
observations.density_layout: The list region is capped at ~255px (16rem rule, styles.css:449) and spent on heading plus callout; the four pages sit below its internal scroll fold.
observations.color: Section tab underline, Type tool and callout rail add three warm marks in one viewport.
observations.visible_affordances: No visible cue that the 255px region scrolls or that pages exist; only the toggle's '−' changes.
observations.coherence: Tab with grey top border, callout card, two disclosure styles and the editor all stacked.

observations.palette_tokens: Token colours; callout rail is the warm warning hue.
observations.shell: The phone page navigator opens onto chrome instead of navigation targets.
observations.accent_discipline: Tab underline + tool underline + callout rail compete in one screen.
observations.suite_cohesion: N/A - only KyNotes captures inspected this round

files.caveat: Synthetic account always shows the recovery callout; real accounts with a saved recovery code would see rows earlier. Rows are reachable by inner scroll (Playwright auto-scrolls), which the image cannot show.

observations.hierarchy: Selected 'Project Atlas' is the clear focal row; section labels group Focus/Notebooks/Team/Account.
observations.typography: '+ New notebook' ~14px next to 17px 'Rename notebook'/'Export notebook' in the same action group.
observations.density_layout: Empty 'Team notebooks' section leaves a ~40px gap before the actions; drawer ends cleanly with 'Pages in' bar and editor below.
observations.color: Neutral sidebar surface; accent only on selected notebook.
observations.visible_affordances: Selected state clear; '−' indicates open; action rows read as tappable text.
observations.coherence: Selected notebook uses a bottom orange border on phone but a left rail on desktop; glyph icons mixed.

observations.shell: Account region present but shows only '4m owner', no sign-out; rail orientation differs from desktop.
observations.suite_cohesion: N/A - only KyNotes captures inspected this round

files.caveat: Unmatched to before: after shows 'Research notes' open (test selected it), before shows 'Launch checklist'.

observations.hierarchy: 'Settings' title, 'Appearance' section and explanatory copy lead into the grid.
observations.density_layout: Even 5-column card grid with 12px gutters; settings nav is a sparse list.
observations.color: Neutral chrome; theme previews are data; selected 'Match system' card has accent border and radio.
observations.visible_affordances: Settings nav shows no current item; header still shows 'Save' and 'Saved to server' on a page with nothing to save.
observations.coherence: Consistent cards; the editor's Save control leaking into Settings is the stray element.

observations.palette_tokens: Chrome on tokens; hues confined to previews.
observations.shell: Settings sidebar lacks a selected row and the account region.
observations.suite_cohesion: N/A - only KyNotes captures inspected this round

files.caveat: Byte-identical to before; unchanged by this diff.

notes.note: before unique: editor-desktop l/d (workspace near-dup), editor-mobile l/d (workspace+pages exact dups), navigation l/d

cohort_rankings.note: Ky-only; no competitor files in scope, so no Ky gap. Not a ranking across cohorts. Overall unique-after mean (not a ranking): 6.72

matched_deltas.cause: BlockNote moved from Inter/muted grey/36px headings to Space 15px ink-strong with 19.5px H2; title 38px light to 28px/600; footer now in view
page list collapsed behind disclosure so the page leads; headings no longer wrap at 36px
before has no disclosure (image = workspace); both show the same 16rem list box with zero rows; after makes it the explicit destination of a control
after page is Research notes, before Launch checklist; drawer itself is unchanged, below-drawer list now collapsed

drift.note: Round 1 for this reviewer; no prior scores loaded. Before images scored after all after images.

keyboard.evidence: web/e2e/ui-council.e2e.ts asserts focus on 'Page title' after phone different-id pick; same-id and notebook-drawer auto-close paths untested

contrast.evidence: 15 named themes have no danger key (src/ky-ui/themes.js); --danger falls back to OS-scheme busnes value (tokens.css:69-107, theme.ts:16) giving 2.14-2.75:1 when theme and OS schemes differ; Nord's own danger #bf616a on #3b4252 = 2.46:1

responsive.evidence: manifest overflow=0 at 390 and 1280 for captured surfaces; phone page list targets hidden behind inner scroll

unscored.reason: scored only for delta, not in means above except cohort_rankings.before
